text.p: Lucent Technologies Inc and Cirrus Logic Inc said on Wednesday they have completed a joint venture agreement to make advanced computer chips.
The venture, named Cirent Semiconductor, will operate as a separate company with board representation from both companies, they said. The venture was announced last October.

"Although the semiconductor industry is not growing as quickly as it did in 1995, we believe this is a temporary slowdown, and I look for the industry to return to double digit growth in 1997 and to continue this expansion at least to the year 2000," Curtis Crawford, president of Lucent Technologies Microelectronics, said in a statement.
In October 1995, Lucent Technologies announced its joint venture with Cirrus Logic to operate the microelectronics manufacturing facility in South Orlando, Fla.
The advanced computer chip plant is undergoing a $600 million expansion and will be home to more than 600 new engineering and technical jobs over the next two years, the companies said.
Construction of a new clean room for the manufacture of integrated circuits on eight-inch silicon wafers is now complete and production is expected to begin in early 1997.
